_doc: Rectangles [x, y, w, h, reason] left out of the pixel diff because what they show differs between any two runs, even of the same shell: live values, a random choice, the phase of an animation that never stops. Keys are fnmatch patterns on shot names, or `layer:NAME` (`layer:NAME+NAME`) for every shot taken while the shell had those layers mapped (layers.txt of the run), whatever the shot is called; every matching line applies. Each one was measured on two runs of one shell (REPORT.md).
